title: 2013 JAMB USE OF ENGLISH QUESTIONS
subject: Use of English
instructions: COMPREHENSION: Read each passage carefully and answer the questions that follow it

questions.question: Which question Paper Type of Uses of English is given to you?
questions.explanation: The paper type is clearly stated as Type B in the question.

questions.question: Which of the following is true according to the passage?
options: Anyone, with almost no training, can run pots on a wheel
Pots can be made quickly and correctly
A pot thrown on a wheel is less likely to break
The potter does not have to work hard if he uses the wheel
questions.explanation: The passage states that 'a small and medium-sized pot can be made more quickly and accurately' using the wheel method.

questions.question: From the passage, how does a potter make several pots of almost identical size?
options: By having the knowledge of different pots
By weighing the lumps of clay
By knowing what to do from experience
questions.explanation: The passage states that 'They are weighed out so that each pot will be roughly the same size'.

questions.question: The phrase 'trims off any waste clay', as used in the passage, means to
options: force the clay to the centre
questions.explanation: To trim off waste clay means to remove or cut away the unnecessary or excess parts of the clay.

questions.question: The word 'congenial', as used in the passage, means
questions.explanation: Congenial means pleasant, agreeable, or nice - suitable for a temporary home environment.

questions.question: Which of the following is true according to the passage?
options: All artistes are objective in their feelings
Music influences feelings at different levels
questions.explanation: The passage discusses how music can enhance various activities and performances.

questions.question: The expression 'stage and hall', as used in the passage, means the
questions.explanation: Stage and hall refers to the interaction between the performer (stage) and the audience (hall).

questions.question: From the passage, it can be deduced that music is
options: better appreciated when we are happy
questions.explanation: The passage shows that music appreciation varies according to different environments and contexts.

questions.question: According to the writer, live performances provide a special excitement because they are
questions.explanation: Live performances are special because each one is unique and cannot be exactly repeated.

questions.question: The word 'resonance', as used in the passage, means
questions.explanation: Resonance refers to the echo or reverberation of sound.
